derivation.method: Agent review of ezdxf drawing add-on or Inkscape rendering and raw entity/layer/units reading; independent ezdxf/svgpathtools curves and GEOS endpoint-network polygonization. No Nestbolt importer used.
derivation.review_note: The single-layer robot drawing mixes an enclosing 300 by 200 mm stock reference, converted annotation lettering and component geometry. Significant open linework and overlapping outlines make automatic cut-part attribution ambiguous; report this and request a clean cut-only export or an explicit selection.
derivation.units: DXF INSUNITS honoured literally; unspecified defaults to mm

expected_failure: Incomplete or ambiguous cut contours. Report open contour locations and gap sizes; offer closure up to 1 mm where applicable, otherwise request a cut-only export. Do not silently return only the enclosed holes as parts.
cut_parts_meaning: No complete automatic cut job: reject with an actionable open/ambiguous-contour report. Empty output is not a successful import.
